_comment: Hand-maintained re-entry rows for the scorecard: a position taken AGAIN in a ticker that already has a row (the first trade closed, stopped or sold). Scorecard picks are auto-derived from articles and keyed by ticker, so one article can only ever produce one row; a re-entry is a separate trade and gets its own row here. Each entry needs its own `anchor` (unique DOM id — the article hero keeps deep-linking to the ORIGINAL row) and carries NO forcedStop / reduced: its trailing stop is scanned live from its own entry date. Read by build.js -> appended to scorecard-recos.json. Entry price follows the normal rule: first close strictly after issueDate. See wiki/scorecard.md 'Re-entry rows'.
